Summary
### Purpose and implementation Fixes Claude proxy-client initialization and request construction. `ClaudeLLMClient` now resolves `api_base` from the constructor argument, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, or the Anthropic default URL. When proxies are configured, it supplies an `anthropic.DefaultAsyncHttpxClient` to `AsyncAnthropic` instead of passing the unsupported `proxies=` argument. It sends stop values as `stop_sequences`, wrapping a string in a list. ### Affected package and configuration Changes affect `dbgpt-core`’s Claude proxy client and its tests. The `ClaudeLLMClient` public API is unchanged. The client continues to use `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` for environment-based URL configuration. ### Risks Proxy mappings use the `"all://"` entry when available, or otherwise only the first value. Other mapping entries are not applied, which may affect callers that rely on per-pattern proxy behavior. Proxy support also depends on the installed Anthropic SDK providing `DefaultAsyncHttpxClient`. ### Tests and verification Tests cover default and explicit API bases, client construction with and without a proxy, and string and list stop values. The PR objectives report that all four tests pass and that Ruff checks are clean; no independent test run is provided here. The tests do not directly cover the environment-variable URL override or proxy mappings. Run targeted checks with: - `pytest packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_claude.py` - `ruff check packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/llms/claude.py packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_claude.py` - `ruff format --check packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/llms/claude.py packages/dbgpt-core/src/dbgpt/model/proxy/tests/test_claude.py` ClaudeLLMClient continues to resolve its API base from an explicit value or `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. It now configures proxy transport through `DefaultAsyncHttpxClient`, omits a custom HTTP client when no proxy is set, and maps stop values to `stop_sequences`.
